attestations.source_locator: September 2026 quarterly Australia All Groups CPI YoY, Table 17. Verified original workbook: 103.64 in September quarter 2026 and 99.73 in September quarter 2025. The existing quarterly adapter rounds the resulting 3.9205856% to one decimal. The release page gives 11:30 a.m. AEDT.

Eurostat Euro indicators 4 November 2026, October 2026 flash estimate. All-items euro area HICP year-on-year: 4.0% (estimate), EA21 for months after December 2025. This is the first flash on the registered headline basis, prior to the final release.

Eurostat Euro indicators 30 October 2026. EA21 headline seasonally adjusted unemployment rate 6.5% in September, total sex and total age as published in the monthly unemployment release, dataset une_rt_m.
Statistics Bureau dated release digest No. 1910, 23 October 2026, highlights of the September 2026 Japan national all-items CPI. Index 102.2 on 2025=100 and official year-on-year all-items rate 2.1%.

Household Labour Force Survey September 2026 quarter. New Zealand headline seasonally adjusted national unemployment rate 5.7%. Stats NZ's same-day release notice states 4 November at 10:45 a.m. New Zealand daylight time.

Employment Situation October 2026, release USDL-26-1632. National CPS U-3 seasonally adjusted unemployment rate for ages 16+, table A-1, 4.1%, published 6 November at 8:30 a.m. Eastern. FRED documents UNRATE as BLS code LNS14000000.
